summary: Dispute at a wellness facility escalated when a roommate reportedly poured hot water on another resident and on bedding and equipment. Officers responded to the facility.
Brush fire reported in a field, possibly being put out by residents. Multiple engines, two battalions and dozers dispatched to the scene.
Domestic disturbance with residents pushing and throwing property. A woman on scene said she was pregnant and had been struck. Units responding.
A caller told store staff that a subject who had just fled had burglarized his residence. Officers investigating.
Welfare check on a 19-year-old woman at a residence who was under the influence and had made suicidal statements. Officers responded.
Medical aid call for a subject with possible mental health issues; fire crews and mental health units dispatched.
A man with his face covered was reported in the Lake Isabella area, with a related report of someone tampering with property. Units searched the area.
Caller canceled the original report; units instead responded for loitering and a disturbance at a convenience store on 34th Street.
Medical aid call in southeast Bakersfield; fire crews responded to the scene.
